_about: Night Drive sounds (tools/night_drive_audio.py): one entry per file in night-drive-web/assets/sfx. Palette: 1980s synthwave: analog polysynths, punchy gated-reverb drums, warm bass, shimmering arpeggios, a retro sports-car engine for the car; key of A minor at 100 BPM; polished, never harsh, no voices.
style: smooth, soft and warm 1980s synthwave game sound, mellow rounded analog synthesizer tones, gentle gated reverb, clean and polished, no distortion, no clipping, no harsh or piercing highs, no hiss, no noise, in A minor, no voice

sfx.name: click
sfx.prompt: a soft short analog synth blip button click, clean

sfx.name: spin
sfx.prompt: a short rising analog synth whoosh as slot reels start spinning, sleek

sfx.name: land
sfx.prompt: a loud punchy single 80s electronic drum hit, a deep synth tom thump with a short gated reverb tail, a slot reel slamming into place

sfx.name: win
sfx.prompt: a bright sparkling synth arpeggio up in A major, a small win chime

sfx.name: winbig
sfx.prompt: a warm gentle synth brass swell followed by a soft rising arpeggio and a shimmering chord, a big win, moderate volume, smooth

sfx.name: wild
sfx.prompt: a retro sports car engine revs once with a bright electric neon zap, a wild symbol landing

sfx.name: scatter
sfx.prompt: a shimmering bell-like synth chime with a soft rising sparkle, a special symbol landing

sfx.name: driveby
sfx.prompt: a sports car gliding past from right to left with a soft smooth doppler whoosh and a mellow synth swell, moderate volume

sfx.name: carmove
sfx.prompt: a short tire chirp and a quick synth swoosh as a car moves one step

sfx.name: nitro
sfx.prompt: a turbo boost whoosh and blow-off with an ascending synth zap, a bonus spin gained

sfx.name: chase
sfx.prompt: a sports car engine roars to life, a big gated drum hit and a heroic synth chord stab, the bonus round begins

sfx.name: bigwin
sfx.prompt: a triumphant 80s synthwave fanfare: gated drums, soaring lead synth melody and a big bright chord

sfx.name: chaseover
sfx.prompt: a warm resolving synth chord with a soft shimmer tail, the bonus round ends

sfx.name: tease
sfx.prompt: a tense rising analog synth riser with a fast ticking pulse, suspense building up as a slot reel slows down, ends unresolved, smooth

sfx.name: stop
sfx.prompt: a crisp punchy short thud as a slot reel stops and the symbols land, a tight analog synth kick with a soft click on top, dry, very short, satisfying

sfx.name: pluck
sfx.prompt: a single short bright analog synth pluck note in A, clean and round, soft attack click, quick decay, one note only

music.name: music-base
music.prompt: Loopable instrumental background music for a 1980s neon night-drive slot game: synthwave at 100 BPM in A minor, punchy gated-reverb drums, a driving analog bass arpeggio, warm lush pads, a catchy memorable lead synth melody, retro and cool, a night drive along an ocean boulevard under neon lights. Medium energy, no big build-ups, no drops, so it can play for an hour. Seamless loop. Instrumental only, no vocals.

music.name: music-chase
music.prompt: Loopable instrumental music for the free-spins chase of a 1980s neon slot game: fast exciting synthwave at 124 BPM in A minor, driving four-on-the-floor gated drums, pulsing bass, urgent arpeggios, a heroic lead synth, a car chase at night. High constant energy, no breakdown. Seamless loop. Instrumental only, no vocals.
